title: Insert Special Characters (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Insert Special Characters applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Special Characters (BtnSpecialChars) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Every picker category is non-empty and free of duplicate characters
scenarios.expected: Every category of SpecialCharacterCatalog carries a header and at least one character, and no category lists the same character twice - before this batch the arrows set listed one arrow twice.

scenarios.title: The language route of the picker matches category headers case-insensitively
scenarios.expected: SpecialCharacterCatalog.FindByHeader resolves a requested language regardless of casing ('german', 'GERMAN', 'czech/slovak') and returns null for a name no category carries.

scenarios.title: The picker offers the documented character sets
scenarios.expected: The German set is exactly the documented umlauts and sharp s, the Harvey Balls set is the five-step progression, Spanish, Mathematical and Polish carry their documented characters, and the arrows set lists its arrow exactly once.

scenarios.title: Emoji and supplementary characters stay whole on their picker buttons
scenarios.expected: SpecialCharacterCatalog.EnumerateGlyphs yields one glyph per text element - the Status & Indicators category yields its 15 glyphs with the flag emoji intact - and no category hands a lone surrogate to the dialog, which used to split every emoji into two broken buttons.
